name: Feature Request

title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: "jaindhruv1923"
---

### Problem Context
A concise description of the functional gap or user need. What institutional workflow is impacted?

### Proposed Solution
A clear, detailed description of what you want to happen. Include data requirements and user persona impact.

### Alternatives Considered
What alternative approaches or workarounds were evaluated? Why is the proposed solution superior?

### Architectural & Schema Impact
- Does this require table schema alterations or new foreign keys?
- Does this impact the 8-vector Composite Risk Score calculation?
- Are there DPDP Act 2023 consent implications?

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Documented requirement specifications.
- [ ] Sub-50ms query latency verified for p99 volume.
- [ ] Zero regression on automated platform telemetry audit.
